meta.title: Lowgear Cycle Works | Bike repair in Hackney
meta.description: Bike servicing, repairs while you wait, wheel building and steel frame restoration in a railway arch off Mare Street, Hackney. Book or just turn up.

rationale: A workshop in a railway arch for couriers, commuters and steel-frame lovers should feel like a price board chalked on a wall: warm concrete background, rust accent, heavy condensed capitals. The ledger shows what things cost at a glance, and the editorial hero puts the practical facts (where, when, walk in) first because customers want the bike back today.

props.detail: Dami and Rosa repair, service and rebuild bikes in a railway arch just off Mare Street. Puncture and brake fixes while you wait.

props.label: Prices
props.title: What it costs
props.intro: Rough prices so you know what to expect. We confirm the exact figure before we start. Parts are extra. Couriers and commuters: tell us when you need the bike back and we will plan around it.

featured.name: Steel frame restoration
featured.description: Strip, repair, repaint and rebuild old steel frames. The job we love most. Priced after we have seen the frame.

photo.subject: A restored steel road frame in fresh paint, hung in the workshop stand with the brick arch behind it

others.name: Brake fix
others.description: Adjust, replace pads or cables. While you wait.

others.name: Basic service
others.description: Safety check, gears and brakes tuned, chain cleaned and oiled, tyres pumped.

others.name: Full service
others.description: Everything in the basic service plus drivetrain deep clean, wheel true and bearing check.

others.name: Wheel building
others.description: Hand-built wheels to suit your rider, your bike and your roads. Parts priced separately.

props.label: Old steel
props.title: The part Dami loves
paragraphs: Most of the bikes through the arch are daily riders, and we keep them moving. But the jobs we look forward to are the old steel frames: the ones with a bit of rust, a dented tube and a story.
We strip them back, look hard at the tubes and joints, fix what needs fixing and rebuild them to ride properly again. Not to sit in a hallway.
If you have a frame in a shed or under a stairwell, bring it in or send us a photo. We will tell you honestly whether it is worth saving.
props.pullQuote: Bring us the frame in the shed.

items.a: Not for punctures and brake fixes, just turn up. For services, wheel builds and frames, booking helps us hold a slot for you.

items.q: Can I get my bike back the same day?
items.a: Usually yes for punctures, brakes and services if you drop it in the morning. Tell us when you need it and we will say straight away if we can.

items.q: Do you work on any kind of bike?
items.a: We mostly see commuter, courier and road bikes, plus old steel frames. Ask us if you are unsure about yours.

items.q: How do I get a price for a restoration?
items.a: Bring the frame in or send photos. We will look at it and give you a figure before any work starts.
